Name: Ador's Wizard Portraits and Deniz's Matching Sprites for Romanceable Rasmodius
Author: ryecci
Description:
[url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/193517]Original portraits[/url] by Ador.﻿ [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/193844]Original sprites[/url] by Deniz. Thank you to Ador for allowing secondary processing and modifications to their work. If any of the original artists wants me to take this down, I will do so immediately!

Rearranged some sprites, portraits, and modified some portrait expressions to be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21607]Romanceable Rasmodius - Updated[/url]. Should also work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romanceable Rasmodius - SVE Compatible[/url]﻿, but I'm not 100% sure since I'm not currently playing SVE.

Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture [/url]to change the portraits. For the sprites, just replace the NewWizard.png in the assets\Characters folder.

Downloads.Description: Updated expressions to be more accurate.
